title: Archaeology RadiocarbonSiteChronology

stats.done_summary: Successfully completed the archaeological radiocarbon chronology research task. Implemented analysis code to calculate conventional radiocarbon ages from F14 ratios, performed simplified calibration to calendar years, generated 7 figures visualizing age distributions, stratigraphic relationships, and material-based patterns. Produced comprehensive report with tables, narrative, and cultural periodization sketch for the Huangtupo site. All deliverables are in place: code in code/, outputs in outputs/, and final report with figures in report/.
